sql: /* Query 7: multi_table_join (player, team, manager) */ SELECT team.championships, manager.age, player.team, player.draft_year, player.age FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name

age.description: age is the age of the team owner, a integer (e.g. 45).
age of the player (if death_date is given, compute as death_date - birth_date; otherwise, compute as 2025/1/1 - birth_date).

draft_year.description: the year the player was selected in the NBA draft; use format YYYY (e.g., 2003).

team.description: the current NBA team the player belongs to, or the last NBA team the player joined if not currently active (e.g., Los Angeles Lakers).
